dimensions.assessment: Affects key federal agency leadership, researchers, and federal and state law enforcement agencies.
dimensions.evidence: Key agency leadership shall jointly develop a standard methodology, based on chemical analysis, for identifying the country of origin of seafood

dimensions.assessment: Involves administrative and technical development of a testing methodology and pilot studies rather than direct broad life-changing mandates for the public.
dimensions.evidence: develop a standard methodology, based on chemical analysis, for identifying the country of origin of seafood

Requires specific federal agencies to collaborate on a new testing methodology, conduct pilot studies, and submit a report to Congress.
dimensions.evidence: Key agency leadership shall jointly develop a standard methodology, based on chemical analysis

dimensions.assessment: Requires a one-time report due not later than 2 years after enactment, while establishing a permanent methodology for enforcement use.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 2 years after the date of the enactment of this Act, the Under Secretary shall submit... a report

importance_detail.rationale: The bill directs federal agencies to develop a standard field methodology and pilot studies using chemical analysis for identifying the country of origin of specific seafood like red snapper and tuna, and requires a report to Congress within two years.
